headlines.title_en: July Shenzhen new commercial housing transactions up over 30% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: According to data from the Shenzhen Real Estate Information Platform, new commercial housing sales in the city totaled 3,773 units in July, down 35.2% month-on-month but up 19.3% year-on-year; residential sales amounted to 2,664 units, down 6.8% month-on-month and up 32.5% year-on-year. Over a longer horizon, cumulative new home sales from January to July reached 35,104 units, up 0.7% year-on-year; residential sales totaled 21,935 units, down 10.6% year-on-year, with the decline narrowing compared with the first half of the year.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title: 日本经济大臣淡化通胀压力，称成本传导仍有限
headlines.summary: 日本经济财政大臣城内实表示，中东冲突导致的成本上涨目前向消费品价格的传导效应仍然有限，并对通胀风险给出了较为乐观的判断。城内实表示：“6月整体消费者价格指数（CPI）同比上涨1.7%，显示价格上涨幅度仍较为温和。”他是在被问及日本央行上周关于“通胀超出预期风险上升”的警告时作出上述回应的。不过，城内实补充称：“我们确实需要保持警惕，成本可能会从今年夏季到秋季逐步传导至食品以及其他消费品价格中。”

headlines.title_en: Japan's economic minister downplays inflation pressure, says cost pass-through remains limited
headlines.summary_en: Japan's Minister of Economic and Fiscal Policy, Minoru Kiuchi, said that the pass-through of cost increases from the Middle East conflict to consumer prices has so far been limited, and gave a relatively optimistic assessment of inflation risks. Kiuchi stated: 'The overall CPI rose 1.7% year-on-year in June, showing that price increases remain relatively moderate.' He made the remarks when asked about the Bank of Japan's warning last week that 'the risk of inflation exceeding expectations has risen.' However, Kiuchi added: 'We do need to remain vigilant, as costs may gradually pass through to food and other consumer goods prices from this summer to autumn.'

headlines.title: 韩国重塑房地产税制 高价值住宅与非自住物业将承担更高税负
headlines.summary: 据韩媒报道，韩国财政部门周一表示，政府将通过削减高价值住宅的税收优惠，大幅提高非自住高价住宅的税负，旨在根据房产所有权和居住情况推动更加公平的税收体系。这一举措是韩国总统李在明推动住房市场正常化、稳定房价以及支持“真正购房者”政策的一部分。政府还计划全面改革税收体系，重点支持培育新的增长动力、推动区域均衡发展，并扶持低收入和中等收入家庭。上述措施均属于韩国企划财政部制定的2026年税制改革方案。

headlines.title_en: South Korea reshapes real estate tax system; high-value homes and non-owner-occupied properties to face higher tax burdens
headlines.summary_en: According to Korean media reports, South Korea's finance ministry said Monday that the government will significantly increase the tax burden on non-owner-occupied high-priced homes by reducing tax benefits for high-value residences, aiming to promote a fairer tax system based on property ownership and occupancy status. The move is part of President Lee Jae-myung's broader policy to normalize the housing market, stabilize prices, and support 'genuine homebuyers.' The government also plans a comprehensive tax reform focused on fostering new growth drivers, promoting balanced regional development, and assisting low- and middle-income households. These measures are part of the 2026 tax reform plan drafted by the Ministry of Economy and Finance.
